Initial data taken from https://njogis-newjersey.opendata.arcgis.com/datasets/municipal-boundaries-of-nj-hosted-3424/explore?location=40.109316%2C-74.749749%2C0.00 and housing data taken from https://www.sustainablejersey.com/fileadmin/media/resources/Data_Center/Community_Profile_Data_by_Municipality_3.12.25.xlsx 

**Note that the acreage/sq miles also includes undeveloped land, so people/sq. mile doesn't represent an density well.  Residential density (housing units / sq. mile) likely better.

**Note that the acreage/sq miles also includes park land and other similarly undeveloped land, so the density doesn't represent an apples to apples comparison for municipalities.  Might be better just to use population unless residential density by municipality dataset can be found.
